opportunities.name: Hotel search, price conversion, and email proposal
opportunities.description: Search Booking.com for a hotel in a city for given dates, convert the price from EUR to a target currency on Xe, and draft a 'Hotel for city, dates' email to a contact with the hotel, EUR price and converted amount.
steps: On Booking.com enter destination city and select check-in and check-out dates
Click Search
Open a hotel result and note its name and EUR price
On Xe converter set the EUR amount to the hotel price
Select the target currency and read the converted amount
In mail click New message, fill To with the contact's email
Type subject 'Hotel for <city>, <dates>'
Type body 'Hi <name>, proposed hotel: <hotel>, <EUR> EUR (about <converted> <currency>). OK to book?'
Discard the draft

instances.values: Frankfurt, Nov 17-20, Vienna House by Wyndham Frankfurt South, 818 EUR -> 915.34 USD, maria@example.com
Milan, Dec 1-4, BB Hotels Aparthotel Visconti, 264 EUR -> 46,794 JPY, kenji@example.com
Amsterdam, Jan 12-15, Jan Luyken Amsterdam, 577 EUR -> 487.44 GBP, aisha@example.com

opportunities.name: City weather and news heads-up email
opportunities.description: Look up a city's 10-day weather forecast, search BBC for '<city> strike' news, and draft a 'Heads-up: <city> on <day>' email with temperatures, conditions and the top headline.
steps: On the weather site search for the city and select it
Open the 10 Day tab and note the forecast for the target day
On BBC open search and enter '<city> strike'
Note the top result headline and date
In mail click New message, fill To
Type subject 'Heads-up: <city> on <day>'
Type body with the recipient name, high/low temps, conditions, and latest news headline with date
Discard the draft

instances.values: Berlin, Saturday, raj@example.com, 58/44 Partly Cloudy, Students strike across Germany
Madrid, Monday, sofia@example.com, 64/50 Partly Cloudy, Villa eye Endrick loan deal
London, Thursday, tom@example.com, 70/56 Cloudy, School support staff strike over pay

opportunities.name: Visa requirements and holidays note
opportunities.description: Look up Wikipedia 'Visa requirements for <nationality> citizens', then look up the destination country's holidays on timeanddate, and save a summary note in the Notes app.
steps: On Wikipedia search 'Visa requirements for <nationality> citizens' and open the page
Read the visa requirement for the destination
On timeanddate open Holidays and select the destination country
Note holidays in the relevant month
In Notes click New note
Type '<Nationality> traveler to <country>: <visa info>, allowed stay not specified. Holidays in <month>: ...' and press Enter
